text: Independent evidence corroborates the 2021 tree-cover loss of **81.3 ha (2.23% of the asset)** via three sources. The **Hansen GFC dataset (2025)** directly maps this loss, while the **JRC GFC2020** confirms 98% of the area was forested in 2020. The **MGAP 2021 forest map** identifies the event area as planted forest (68.1 ha), primarily *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*. Observability is robust, with full spatial coverage (30m pixels) and annual temporal resolution (2001–2025).
